site_title: MAIC-DB — Mechanically Activated Ion Channel Database
home_about_background: Mechanotransduction entered a golden age after the 2021 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine recognised the discovery of PIEZO channels. Yet the quantitative data on how cells sense and respond to mechanical force remains fragmented across thousands of papers — a Tower of Babel of heterogeneous units, protocols, and reporting standards.
home_about_objective: MAIC-DB answers that by curating the quantitative biophysical parameters of mechanically activated ion channels that existing bioinformatics resources leave out, linking gene identity to protein biophysics and on to cellular mechanics. Every measurement keeps its verbatim evidence quote, so each number traces back to the sentence it came from.
home_usage_browse: Pick a family in the guide on the left, then open a channel to see its measurement rows.
home_usage_evidence: Expand any row to read the quote, location, confidence, and condition key behind the number.
home_usage_parameters: Compare one parameter across all channels on the Parameters pages, grouped by stored unit.
home_usage_search: Search gene symbols, aliases, UniProt IDs, families, and parameters from the box in the header.
home_usage_downloads: Download the full data artifact and its citation details on the Downloads page.

parameters_index_intro: Cross-family comparison — one page per registered parameter, every channel listed with count/min/median/max per stored unit.
param_unit_disclosure: Buckets are split by stored unit: values are rendered as recorded, units are never merged or converted (unit normalization is a human curation decision pending a future data release).
ratio_median_note: median omitted: ratio_direction is NULL on every row this load, and cross-direction medians are meaningless (A1 panel p4 semantics — direction-unstated groups report count/min/max only)
footer_ai_disclosure: Substantial literature mining, code implementation, and review preparation was executed by AI agents under human direction; every merge passed an independent review gate.
analysis_intro: Cross-corpus views computed from the published artifact by the analysis library (spec §5–§6): every number on these pages traces to a census SQL or a committed analysis module, and every table carries its n and k.
analysis_audit_summary: Tri-state field status across the 948 experiments (ADR-0005 applicability), the pre/post-PIEZO era contrast, breakdowns, and the vault §9 four-field headline under both readings.
analysis_atlas_summary: ΔP50 effect sizes, the compound × channel pActivity matrix, and per-compound selectivity — honest about sparsity and about the data this release does not yet carry.
analysis_trends_summary: The corpus's growth curve, parameter adoption by year, and drift of recording modes and expression systems across 33 years of literature.
analysis_methods_summary: Every statistical choice behind these pages: scales, pooling rules, the random-effects model and its identifiability gate, and what stays descriptive at this n.
analysis_biophysics_summary: DerSimonian–Laird pooled activation thresholds per (family, stimulus), the kinetics atlas, and between-publication spread — figures below, full tables in the release JSON.
fig_alt_forest: Forest plot of pooled median activation thresholds by family and stimulus mode
fig_alt_pubs: Bar chart of publications per year
fig_alt_compliance: Mean MIMIC compliance by publication year
fig_alt_adoption: Heatmap of parameter rows by year and parameter
audit_intro: Every experiment record scored field-by-field against the MIMIC standard (P2), aggregated here per field and per family (P3). Tri-state statuses: REPORTED, NOT_REPORTED_IN_PAPER, NOT_EXTRACTED; denominators are applicable sets per ADR-0005, never raw row counts.
audit_era_piezo_note: Era boundary 2010: the PIEZO1 cloning paper (records without a year are counted separately).
audit_provenance_note: Statuses: a field is REPORTED when its value is present, NOT_REPORTED_IN_PAPER when the source states it was not measured, NOT_EXTRACTED otherwise (the artifact predates the mimic_gaps column, so empty fields score NOT_EXTRACTED — the hybrid's honest default). A cell's compliance is undefined (—) when no record of that slice has the field applicable.
bio_thresholds_note: Pooled geometric means of |P50| on the log scale (mmHg, dual-reported in kPa in the release JSON). Cells without a multi-record publication stay descriptive — no CI, no τ², no I².
bio_heterogeneity_note: Across inference-eligible cells I² spans 0.61–0.97: between-publication heterogeneity is the dominant signal, and the prediction intervals are wide by construction.
atlas_intro: The ΔP50 effect-size table, the compound × channel pActivity matrix (P1's harmonized −log10 molar axis), and the per-compound selectivity index. Disclosed at this release: structure.residues_covered is NULL on all 12 structures (the variant→domain mapping is implemented but vacuously empty), and bioactivity.pchembl is NULL on all 136 rows (p_activity is the only value axis).
atlas_delta_note: No inferential statistics at this n (spec §5.3). All data-v1.0 rows are mmHg as reported.
atlas_matrix_note: Cell value = mean of resolved pActivities (n carried per cell). Cells with measurements but no resolvable value (mass-concentration rows without molecular weight, NULL units) show —: no data, not zero.
atlas_selectivity_note: Best-channel pActivity minus best off-target (second-best); compounds populating one channel have no measurable off-target gap.
trends_intro: How the corpus grew and what it measured, year by year (P6). Per-family year cells count distinct publications and are therefore NOT additive to the yearly total — the total column is its own distinct-publication count.
trends_adoption_note: Rows = registered parameters, cells = records carrying a value that year (log-proportional shading). A parameter's first populated year is its adoption point.
methods_intro: The statistical choices behind the Analysis section, stated once with their reasons (spec §5–§6). Where the data cannot support a statistic, the page says so instead of computing it.
methods_tri_state_body: Each MIMIC field on each record is REPORTED, NOT_REPORTED_IN_PAPER, or NOT_EXTRACTED. Applicability rules (ADR-0005) gate each field: stimulus velocity and probe geometry only for moving-probe stimuli, pipette solution and holding potential only for pipette-based modes, sampling and filter rates for named electrophysiological modes. Compliance divides reported by APPLICABLE — never by raw row counts.
methods_scales_body: Thresholds (P50) and kinetics are analyzed on the log scale; summaries are geometric means with n (records) and k (publications) always attached. P50 is dual-reported in mmHg and kPa (exact factor 0.133322387415); kinetics stay in column-native ms; T50 in mN/m; X50 in µm.
methods_pooling_body: No pooling across stimulus modalities or assay formats: every cell of the biophysics analysis is one (family, stimulus) pair, and the trends pages never mix recording modes or expression systems within a count.
methods_dl_heading: Random effects and the identifiability gate
methods_dl_body: Between-cell synthesis uses the DerSimonian–Laird estimator on log10 |P50| with the DerSimonian–Laird moment estimate of τ². The spec's planned publication × condition cluster degenerates at this release (every record has a unique condition key), so clusters fall back to publications. A cell without at least one multi-record publication has no within-cluster variance: those cells stay descriptive — pooled mean only, no confidence interval, no prediction interval, no τ², no Q, no I². Intervals use the Higgins (t-based) prediction form.
methods_signs_body: 88 of 152 reported P50 values are negative, with mixed signs inside single (family, stimulus) cells — papers state suction and clamp thresholds under different conventions. The analysis pools magnitudes (log10 |P50|) and discloses the per-cell sign split rather than silently flipping signs; signed ranges are kept as reported in the lab-spread view.
methods_basis_body: Compound activities enter as pActivity = −log10(molar concentration). Measurements in mass-concentration units without a molecular weight (4 rows), with NULL units (3), or already on a log scale (1) keep their disclosed basis and contribute no numeric value; pchembl is NULL corpus-wide at this release, so no other value axis exists.
methods_selectivity_body: Per compound with resolvable values on two or more channels: best-channel pActivity minus the second-best. Ties resolve deterministically by gene-symbol order and the gap is 0 — a property of the definition, disclosed in the tests. The index is descriptive; it is not an affinity ranking across assay formats.
methods_descriptive_body: Low-n outputs carry no inferential statistics (spec §5.3's ΔP50 table, the kinetics atlas at small k). Multiple-comparison corrections exist only where formal tests run (the heterogeneity contrasts); the audit track runs no hypothesis tests at v1. Every number on these pages traces to a census SQL or a committed analysis module pinned by tests.
card_mimic_aria: MIMIC compliance for this channel's records
card_mimic_note: share of applicable MIMIC fields reported across this channel's records (field-level, ADR-0005)
audit_four_field_any_note: Two readings of the same list: as written (vault §9's own reading, applicability ignored) a record fails when any listed field is absent; ADR-aware counts a failure only when the field is applicable (ADR-0005). The last row aggregates per-record any-field failure under both readings — the numbers live in the row above this note, not here.
trends_by_family_note: A dash means no publication that year — absence, not zero; the family columns are distinct-publication counts (a paper covering two families counts in both).
